_note: Every field carries its own source status. verified=false means no public source exists for that number yet — pages must render a gap rather than a plausible guess. Codes are corroborated by two independent listings (checked 2026-09-26); pets carry their own source note. Source list and the reason each gap exists are on /about/.

redeemSteps: Open the Shop / Codes menu (the codes button sits next to the in-game shop).
Paste a code exactly as written — they are case-sensitive.
Press Redeem and the potions or fruit land in your inventory.

systems.name: Pets
systems.detail: The game says 'hundreds of unique pets', hatched from eggs and tradeable — the title itself carries [TRADES].

systems.name: Eggs
systems.detail: Bought with Coins. The Fantasy World update added an exclusive egg line on top of the standard set.

systems.name: Coins
systems.detail: The main currency. Farmed from breakables and normal play, spent on eggs.

systems.name: Rubies
systems.detail: The second currency. Premium subscribers earn +10% Coins and Rubies.

systems.name: Potions
systems.detail: Coins, Luck, Hatch, Critical and Rubies potions. Codes hand them out; Luck and Hatch potions tilt egg odds.

systems.name: Fruits
systems.detail: Apples, Bananas, Blueberries, Kiwis and Mangos — burned through during hatching runs and tracked by the Fruits Mastery badge.

systems.name: Breakables
systems.detail: Destructible objects around the map that drop Coins; tracked by the Breakables Mastery badge.

systems.name: Mastery badges
systems.detail: Five in-game badges — Fruits, Eggs, Playtime, Breakables and Potions — record long-run progress and are the only public stat the game exposes.

systems.name: Worlds
systems.detail: A Fantasy World (crafting plus exclusive eggs) and the new world that arrived with the trading update.

systems.name: Charms
systems.detail: Equippable boosts added in the trading update.

systems.name: Trading
systems.detail: Player-to-player trades. This is why a value list matters — and why its absence is the site's first gap to close.

systems.name: Premium and group
systems.detail: Premium grants +10% Coins and Rubies; joining the Lip Builds group unlocks bonus rewards.

gaps: The full pet list and each pet's hatch odds. The game advertises 'hundreds of pets' and publishes no index; the only confirmed names are the ones printed on its own artwork.
Trading values. No public value list exists for this game yet — the Discord is where trades are negotiated.
Drop rates for fruits, potions and charms.
Which rarity labels belong to which pet beyond Pop Cat (the artwork shows 1 in 10m and 1/999m but does not label them clearly).
